title: ResolvedContext
description: The resolver's output (0007): the effective rule-set a subject operates under, composed deterministically from the inherited chain — one resolver, per-field merge laws (floors tighten-only · soft most-specific-wins · skills additive · dials per their monotone directions). CONTENT-ADDRESSED: same chain ⇒ same id, so policy is cacheable, diffable, and canary-able like everything else. Locked 2026-07-02: RunRecords pin the context_hash they executed under; partitioned nodes fail closed on their last-known context.

id.description: Hash of the canonical resolved content — the policy version a run pins.

subject.description: Optional: resolved for a specific principal (Selector-filtered).

floors.description: The tighten-only merged floor set (enforced at publication; composed here). Floors always beat soft.

from_scope.description: Which tier won — most-specific-wins, tiebreak by version then id, never silent.

skills.description: Additive union along the chain; same name ⇒ higher version wins.

stale.description: true ⇒ served from the last-known view under partition (fail-closed; a vigil signal — staleness escalates, 0012).

as_of.description: What the resolver saw, tier by tier — honest staleness, never silent.
